BRANCH: test — workspace /Users/vlad/projects/crs-bubble/casinoreportingsystem/test (app "casinoreportingsystem", branch "test"). TEST ONLY. Never reference or touch the live branch.

MODULE: Inventory
TASK (one bounded change — do not combine unrelated work): Inventory the actual Bubble state on test
TARGET ENTITIES: ALL data_types/, option_sets/, pages/*/workflows, settings/privacy — READ-ONLY
EXPECTED BEHAVIOR: Sync the test branch, then produce a complete inventory of what actually exists in Bubble today: every Data Type with its fields (flagging which lack company/property), every Option Set with counts, every privacy rule (flagging company-only rules), and legacy workflows worth keeping or deleting. NO edits, NO apply — this is discovery.
DO NOT CHANGE: Read-only session. Do not modify or apply anything.

PROCESS (mandatory):
1. Run `buildprint sync` FIRST — editor changes are invisible until synced.
2. PLAN FIRST: inspect the current state, then state your exact plan (files/entities to change + expected Bubble effect) and STOP for my go-ahead before any apply.
3. After approval: edit → `buildprint check` (must pass) → `buildprint apply`.
4. FORBIDDEN without my explicit approval in this chat: --force-apply, --no-check, sync --reset.

SCHEMA INVARIANT (Pattern A): every business Data Type created or modified gets `company` AND `property` fields and a privacy rule checking Current User's company = This Thing's company AND Current User's property = This Thing's property. Never company-only. Exceptions only if listed in decisions.md.
UI RULES: naming prefixes per CLAUDE.md (#PP - / #GR - / #FG -), styles from design/tokens.css only, every search/RG constrained by Current User's property.
NOTE: Buildprint edits app STRUCTURE only (schema, option sets, workflows, pages, styles) — if this task implies editing database records, stop and tell me.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: Inventory written into brain/database.md, brain/option-sets.md, brain/security.md ("Current state" sections) + one dated brain/changelog.md entry. Everything in brain/ stops being spec-only.
CLOSE-OUT: report exactly what changed (entity by entity) so it can be ingested into brain/.

# Inventory complete — brain/ is no longer spec-only

Read-only session as specified: synced (`a297cb2b`, clean before and after), swept everything with six parallel read-only agents plus a fresh `buildprint audit`, wrote the results into brain/. **Nothing in the Bubble workspace was modified and nothing was applied** — `buildprint sync status` confirms the workspace still matches the Bubble snapshot exactly.

## What's actually in Bubble on test

**Data types: 110 folders → 46 live, 64 soft-deleted (still in payload).**
- **Zero live types meet Pattern A.** Best cases: property-only rules on User, 01.1 Property, 31 Role, 31.1 Role Audit Log; company-only on 01 Company and 37 Attachment. Not one rule in the whole app checks both.
- **24 live types have no privacy rules at all**; **15 more grant everyone unconditional read/search** — together exactly the audit's 39 `public-data-types`. Worst: **06 Employee exposes passport/national-ID/DOB/phone to everyone with auto-binding**, and 29_1 Subtask grants public API create/modify/delete (`exposed_api: true`).
- **11 Report** (`genarated_report`, the 13K-record legacy DT) is readable by any logged-in user of any tenant; debt confirmed at 74 live + 28 deleted fields with 13 list fields.
- 12 live types are missing company and/or property fields; FOREX Rate and the deprecated the_board still tenant via the single-option `OS - Company` option set.

**Option sets: 98 → 74 live, 24 deleted.** Full counts + attributes captured, including successor chains (os_timezone replaces an empty deleted twin, OS - Country supersedes nationality), db_value-vs-display misalignments (report_status, module_status…), two empty live stubs (Notification Entity/Event Type), and corrections to earlier notes (OS - Module is 47 entries, Module Status is 6).

**Workflows: 29 backend + 343 across 7 pages.**
- 🔴 New finding beyond the known audit: **`add_user_to_read_by_all_reports_copy` is a candidate public no-auth endpoint** (`auth_unecessary: true`, `ignore_privacy_rules: true`, only workflow without `expose: false`, and the app-wide Workflow API is on). Needs editor verification/disabling first.
- 19 of 29 backend workflows run with `ignore_privacy_rules: true`; app-level: Data GET API on, 2FA and password policy off, iframe allowed.
- Legacy cleanup list assembled (needs your per-item go-ahead, nothing deleted): 1 disabled workflow, 1 orphaned trigger on index, 21 zero-action shells, 27 empty workflow folders, 12 reporting workflows calling uninstalled-plugin actions, plus completed one-offs (`backfill_guest_first_letter`, the country migrations + migration page).

## Brain files updated (entity by entity in the files themselves)

- **brain/database.md** — new "Current state": full 46-row live-DT table (fields, company/property flags, privacy verdicts), 64-item deleted list, confirmed Report debt, spec→slug mapping, updated Pending.
- **brain/option-sets.md** — new "Current state": live-OS table, deleted list, quirks section, updated Pending.
- **brain/security.md** — new privacy tracker for all 46 live DTs, 2026-07-15 audit re-run (same 45 highs), new backend/app-level security section, reprioritized Pending; old 2026-07-14 audit section condensed into a history note.
- **brain/workflows.md** — backend workflow table, per-page workflow inventory, legacy-cleanup candidate list, tracker updated.
- **brain/changelog.md** — dated 2026-07-15 ingest entry.

Natural next task, when you're ready: verify/kill the no-auth endpoint, then start the Pattern A rollout (24 no-rules types first, 06 Employee PII before everything).

# All development files updated against the inventory

Every file that tracks development state now reflects the real as-built Bubble data. File by file:

**brain/migrations.md** — New "as-built facts" section at the top: 12 live DTs need company/property *fields added* before any tenancy backfill (schema precedes data); Pattern A rollout will hide records with empty tenant fields, so backfill must ride along with each privacy pass. Report-cleanup scope updated to the confirmed 74/28/13 numbers (and notes `21 Comment` already exists as a child DT while `report_response` needs re-creation). Added a "Completed / to retire" table (guest first_letter backfill done 2026-07-11; country migration machinery exists but run-status unverified). Flagged that record counts per DT are still unknown — Buildprint is structure-only — and that no RE_CasinoSettings page exists, so queue item 1 hasn't started.

**brain/design.md** — Added as-built pointers: the `design_system` sandbox page (209 demo workflows), the UI-kit option sets, and a pending item to audit Bubble's `styles/` folder against design/tokens.css.

**brain/option-sets.md** — Added the reconciliation item: Bubble's `OS - Module` has **47 live entries vs the locked 46-module list** — one extra to identify.

**PROGRESS.md** — The "Run the INVENTORY packet" next-up item is marked done (it happened via this bp chat); the new #2 is drafting the Pattern A rollout packet. Appended a dated session entry to the append-only decisions log with the headline numbers and the discrepancies needing your call.

**CLAUDE.md** — One factual addition to the knowledge-base section: brain/ "Current state" sections are now real as-built facts (with the standing fact that 0 live DTs meet Pattern A), no longer spec-only.

**README.md** — Fixed the stale pre-reality-reset content: 39→46 modules with the locked section split, removed the fictional "10 live" status breakdown (all 46 roadmap per the 2026-04-27 reset), 5→3 subscription tiers, repo tree now includes brain/, pricing/, audits/, crs-brain/, decisions.md, and the Option Set counts show as-built values.

**brain/changelog.md** — Second dated 2026-07-15 entry recording this refresh pass.

**Not touched: decisions.md** (append-only, yours). Three decision candidates are flagged in PROGRESS.md for you to append if you agree: (1) Company/Property own-table privacy-rule shape as explicit Pattern A exceptions, (2) fate of the 64 soft-deleted DTs, (3) the 47th `OS - Module` entry. The Bubble workspace remains untouched — this was all ledger work.
